verdict.rationale: The pack shows Infrastructure Manager defining infrastructure declaratively with Terraform and offering preview deployments of planned changes. It contains nothing documenting importing existing resources into IaC or detecting and reconciling drift. Preview of changes is a different capability from drift detection or import. API hub's discovery of existing APIs is a separate API-catalog feature, not IaC import.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, existing resources can come under IaC — documented import/drift workflows instead of a greenfield-only story
